name: Convex 'All Gas, No Breakages' OG social card by convex.dev
description: A 1200×630 social card that reads like a screen-printed poster: a warm cream field with a faint graph-paper grid, a two-line all-caps headline in a very heavy grotesque (~120px, line-height ≈0.95) pinned to the upper left, and a signature ribbon of flat stripes — amber, red-orange and purple nested inside a near-black L-shaped frame — running along the bottom before making one shared rounded 90° turn up the right edge. Focal order is headline → colour ribbon → cream-on-dark wordmark lockup in the bottom-left band. Everything is flat fill with no gradients, shadows or photography, so the black type and the three saturated stripe colours carry all the contrast.
